semantic_correction: Book-pressure equilibrium or liquidity-vacuum repair, not fixed 1c/2c retracements. Fixed price ladders are controls only.

parent_scope.cohort: All original first signals per parent/market, including failed/partial/missed/expired cases. Never select on later fills/PnL.
parent_scope.feedback_policy: Original fill-dependent re-entry requires its own causal feedback state, never reuse original-fill-derived future opportunities.

gate_semantics: Displayed-depth proxies only; no market-maker identity, cancellation-vs-fill or emotional-mispricing proof. Excursion is relative to arm midpoint.
execution: FAK after causal gate; fix limit from directly received quote; preserve all failures/partials/fees/cash reservations and shared snapshot depth. Measure price improvement, do not assume it.
formal_ranking_note: Fractional entry legs are auxiliary allocation experiments, not unchanged 100shares-per-order formal ranking.
data_contract: Atomic full frame before evaluation; equal-clock subrows are not separate wall observations.
Use local receipts/lifecycle and exact input/code hashes.
Trade side audit-only until semantic proof; no tick-sign aggressor substitute.
Daily trade integer-millisecond receipts need clock/lifecycle/duplicate proof before joining strict submillisecond books.
Old fixed-grid projections cannot price new raw-event decision times; rebuild causal snapshots at new decisions and actual matching horizons.
External BTC L2 must not be inferred from BBO-only exports.
